passiveEffects.name: Blaze
passiveEffects.originalDescription: When using a move while at low remaining HP, deal additional damage with a fireball to enemies. This Ability goes on cooldown after it’s triggered. When using a move when below 50% max HP, that move deals additional damage with a fireball to enemies (15s CD).

uniteMoveEffects.name: Fanciful Fireworks
uniteMoveEffects.originalDescription: Deals damage-over-time to enemies in the designated area-of-effect. Enemies that are hit have decreased movement speed and weakened HP recovery effects for a short time. Deals damage-over-time to enemies in the designated area for 8s. Enemies that are hit have 50% decreased movement speed and 50% reduced HP recovery effects for 1.75s. Recovery effects are weakened within the zone and cannot be cleansed while in the zone. Leaving the zone will have the weakened HP recovery effects linger for 1.75s and may be cleansed after leaving the zone. 8s duration (ticks at 0.5s intervals). Unite buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
